name: Andy Galvin
source:
Andy is a seven-year-old boy who lives in the house next to Harry and Cheryl Mason. He is the main character of four scenarios that could be downloaded into the Silent Hill: Play Novel cartridge via cellphone. The four scenarios were named for each of the seasons: Spring, Summer, Fall and Winter.

Since the service no longer exists, the only information available on Andy is in the Play Novel Official Guidebook, which only gives details of the Spring Scenario. [SPOILER]It is possible that Andy dies, because he falls down a hole and is "unable to move", but this is not certain. The guidebook also contains two pictures from other scenarios, depicting Andy talking to Cheryl and seeing Alessa in the yard. For both Spring Scenario endings, the player receives the "First Sight" digital trading card. There are two other Andy digital trading cards: one called "Love", which depicts Andy and Alessa Gillespie, and one called "Escape", which shows Andy and Cheryl running off together.

Andy also appears in Cybil Bennett's scenario as the boy in the water. He fights with Cheryl on the aqueduct and falls in. Later, he is rescued by Cybil.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://silenthill.fandom.com/wiki/Andy]Silent Hill Wiki[/url]]
